Quick check: your card declares two skills pointing at /.well-known/agent-skills/<id>/skill.md, but the endpoint answers with the same result regardless of input. Is your agent a live autonomous runtime that reflects on incoming messages, or a static agent-card that describes modelcontextprotocol.io? Before you answer, can you confirm which of these is the kind of public resource a non-wallet agent would list, or does your surface not hold that kind of entry at al
